Script.name: shinykeep_script
Script.script:
-- shinykeep (Mudlet script start) -- Ported from mush scripts/g_shinykeep.xml
if not shinykeep then shinykeep = {} end
shinykeep.TIERS = { [1] = {"((Godly))"}, [2] = {"(Fabled)","(Divine)","(Mythical)","(Epic)","(Legendary)"}, [3] = {"(Eternal)","(Exalted)","(Majestic)","(Wondrous)","(Radiant)"}, [4] = {"(Brilliant)","(Dazzling)","(Shimmering)","(Gleaming)","(Sparkling)"}, [5] = {"(Vibrant)","(Shiny)","(Burnished)","(Enhanced)","(Polished)"}, } shinykeep.pendingItems = shinykeep.pendingItems or {} shinykeep.processedItems = shinykeep.processedItems or {} shinykeep.freshAddedItems = shinykeep.freshAddedItems or {} shinykeep.lastDinvRevision = tonumber(shinykeep.lastDinvRevision) shinykeep.pendingRetryCount = tonumber(shinykeep.pendingRetryCount) or 0
local DINV_ITEM_FIELDS = { "id", "name", "colorName", "normalizedName", "type", "flags", "keepflag", "identifyLevel", "rarity", "rarityPrefix", "rarityMarker", "quality", }
local function vname(tier) return "shinykeep_include" .. tostring(tier) end
local function persistence_dir() local home = (type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or ".") local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir end
local STATE_FILE = persistence_dir() .. "/shinykeep_state.lua" local saved_state = {} local function lua_serialize(value) local t = type(value) if t == "number" or t == "boolean" then return tostring(value) end if t == "string" then return string.format("%q", value) end if t == "table" then local out = {"{"} for k, v in pairs(value) do local key = (type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$")) and k or ("[" .. lua_serialize(k) .. "]") out[#out + 1] = key .. " = " .. lua_serialize(v) .. "," end out[#out + 1] = "}" return table.concat(out, " ") end return "nil" end
local function load_saved() local function resolve_table_save_refs(node, root, seen) if type(node) ~= "table" then return node end if rawget(node, 1) ~= nil and rawget(node, 2) == nil and next(node, 1) == nil and type(node[1]) == "number" and type(root[node[1]]) == "table" then return resolve_table_save_refs(root[node[1]], root, seen) end seen = seen or {} if seen[node] then return seen[node] end local out = {} seen[node] = out for k, v in pairs(node) do out[resolve_table_save_refs(k, root, seen)] = resolve_table_save_refs(v, root, seen) end return out end
local loaded = nil local ok, data = pcall(dofile, STATE_FILE) if ok and type(data) == "table" then loaded = data if type(loaded[1]) == "table" and type(loaded["showmain"]) == "nil" then loaded = resolve_table_save_refs(loaded[1], loaded, {}) end end if not loaded and type(table) == "table" and type(table.load) == "function" then local f = io.open(STATE_FILE, "r") if f then f:close() local ok2, data2 = pcall(table.load, STATE_FILE) if ok2 and type(data2) == "table" then loaded = data2 end end end saved_state = type(loaded) == "table" and loaded or {} end
local function get_saved(name) return saved_state[name] end
local function set_saved(name, value) saved_state[name] = value end
local function save_saved() local f = io.open(STATE_FILE, "w") if f then f:write("return " .. lua_serialize(saved_state)) f:close() end end
local function set_default(name, default_value) if get_saved(name) == nil then set_saved(name, tostring(default_value)) return true end return false end
local function bget(name) local v = get_saved(name) return v == "1" or v == "y" or v == "Y" or v == "true" end
local function bset(name, on) set_saved(name, on and "1" or "0") save_saved() end
local function strip_dinv_colours(value) local text = tostring(value or "") text = text:gsub("@.", "") text = text:gsub("<[^>]+>", "") text = text:gsub("%s+", " ") text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") return text end
local function compact_marker(value) return strip_dinv_colours(value):lower():gsub("[%(%)%s]", "") end
local function detect_tier(tag) local cleaned = strip_dinv_colours(tag) if cleaned == "" then return nil end
local needle = cleaned:lower() local compact = compact_marker(cleaned) for tier = 1, 5 do for _, prefix in ipairs(shinykeep.TIERS[tier]) do local lowered = prefix:lower() if needle == lowered or needle:sub(1, #lowered + 1) == lowered .. " " or compact == compact_marker(prefix) then return tier, prefix end end end
return nil end
local function detect_item_tier(item) if type(item) ~= "table" then return nil end
for _, field in ipairs({"rarityPrefix", "rarityMarker", "rarity", "quality"}) do local tier, prefix = detect_tier(item[field]) if tier then return tier, prefix end end
return detect_tier(item.colorName or item.name or item.normalizedName) end
local function dinv_api_available() return type(DINV) == "table" and type(DINV.api) == "table" and type(DINV.api.getItem) == "function" end
local function dinv_revision() if type(DINV) == "table" and type(DINV.api) == "table" and type(DINV.api.getRevision) == "function" then local ok, revision = pcall(DINV.api.getRevision) if ok then return tonumber(revision) end end return nil end
local function get_dinv_item(objId) if not dinv_api_available() then return nil end
local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getItem, tostring(objId), { source = "live", fields = DINV_ITEM_FIELDS, }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok and type(result.item) == "table" then return result.item end
if type(DINV.api.search) == "function" then local searchOk, searchResult = pcall(DINV.api.search, tostring(objId), { source = "live", fields = DINV_ITEM_FIELDS, limit = 1, }) if searchOk and type(searchResult) == "table" and searchResult.ok and type(searchResult.items) == "table" then return searchResult.items[1] end end
return nil end
local function item_has_dinv_identity(item) if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
local name = strip_dinv_colours(item.colorName or item.name or item.normalizedName) local itemType = strip_dinv_colours(item.type) if name == "" or name == "unknown item" then return false end if itemType == "" or itemType:lower() == "unknown" then return false end
return true end
local function item_is_already_kept(item) if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
local keepflag = item.keepflag if keepflag == true or tostring(keepflag):lower() == "true" or tostring(keepflag) == "1" then return true end
local protocolFlags = tostring(item.flags or "") return protocolFlags:find("K", 1, true) ~= nil end
local function keep_dinv_item(item) local objId = tostring(item and item.id or "") if objId == "" then return false end
send("keep " .. objId, false) return true end
function SK_EvaluateDINVItem(objId, payloadItem, options) options = options or {} local id = tostring(objId or "") local freshAdded = options.freshAdded == true or shinykeep.freshAddedItems[id] == true if id == "" then return true end if shinykeep.processedItems[id] and not freshAdded then return true end
local item = type(payloadItem) == "table" and payloadItem or nil if not item_has_dinv_identity(item) then item = get_dinv_item(id) end
if not item_has_dinv_identity(item) then shinykeep.pendingItems[id] = true return false end
shinykeep.pendingItems[id] = nil shinykeep.freshAddedItems[id] = nil shinykeep.processedItems[id] = true
local tier, prefix = detect_item_tier(item) if not tier or not prefix then return true end
if not bget(vname(tier)) then return true end
if not freshAdded and item_is_already_kept(item) then return true end
keep_dinv_item(item) return true end
function SK_OnDINVInventoryChanged(payload) payload = payload or {} local item = type(payload.item) == "table" and payload.item or nil local id = tostring(payload.id or (item and item.id) or "") if id == "" then return end
local action = tostring(payload.action or "") if action == "removed" then shinykeep.pendingItems[id] = nil shinykeep.processedItems[id] = nil shinykeep.freshAddedItems[id] = nil return end
if action == "added" then shinykeep.pendingItems[id] = true shinykeep.processedItems[id] = nil shinykeep.freshAddedItems[id] = true end
if shinykeep.pendingItems[id] or action == "added" then SK_EvaluateDINVItem(id, item, { freshAdded = action == "added" }) end end
function SK_PollDINV() if not (dinv_api_available() and type(DINV.api.getChangesSince) == "function") then return false end
local revision = dinv_revision() if not revision then return false end
local fromRevision = shinykeep.lastDinvRevision if not fromRevision then fromRevision = math.max(0, revision - 1) end
if revision <= fromRevision then shinykeep.lastDinvRevision = revision return true end
local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getChangesSince, fromRevision, { source = "live", }) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then return false end
local newest = fromRevision for _, change in ipairs(result.changes or {}) do SK_OnDINVInventoryChanged(change) newest = math.max(newest, tonumber(change.revision) or newest) end
shinykeep.lastDinvRevision = math.max(newest, tonumber(result.revision) or newest, revision) return true end
local function has_pending_items() for _ in pairs(shinykeep.pendingItems or {}) do return true end return false end
local function retry_pending_items() for id in pairs(shinykeep.pendingItems or {}) do SK_EvaluateDINVItem(id, nil, { freshAdded = shinykeep.freshAddedItems[id] == true }) end return has_pending_items() end
function SK_RunDINVRefresh() shinykeep.dinvRefreshTimer = nil SK_PollDINV()
if retry_pending_items() then shinykeep.pendingRetryCount = (tonumber(shinykeep.pendingRetryCount) or 0) + 1 if shinykeep.pendingRetryCount <= 8 then SK_RequestDINVRefresh(1) end else shinykeep.pendingRetryCount = 0 end end
function SK_RequestDINVRefresh(delay) delay = tonumber(delay) or 0.1 if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then SK_PollDINV() retry_pending_items() return true end if shinykeep.dinvRefreshTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, shinykeep.dinvRefreshTimer) shinykeep.dinvRefreshTimer = nil end shinykeep.dinvRefreshTimer = tempTimer(delay, [[SK_RunDINVRefresh()]]) return true end
function SK_OnInvmon(payload) SK_RequestDINVRefresh(0.1) end
function SK_OnDINVReady() SK_RunDINVRefresh() end
local function register_dinv_ready_handler() shinykeep.lastDinvRevision = dinv_revision() or shinykeep.lastDinvRevision return true end
local function print_line(color, text) if color and color ~= "" then fg(color) end echo(text .. "\n") resetFormat() end
local function print_tier_status(tier) local prefixes = table.concat(shinykeep.TIERS[tier], ", ") local enabled = bget(vname(tier))
fg("gray") echo(string.format(" #%d: ", tier)) fg("gray") echo(prefixes) fg("gray") echo(" - ") if enabled then fg("LimeGreen") echo("INCLUDED") else fg("red") echo("EXCLUDED") end echo("\n") resetFormat() end
function SK_OnLootAny(tag) -- Legacy loot-line hook. The active path watches {invmon} and then reads DINV changes. end
function SK_Include(tier) local n = tonumber(tier) if not n or n < 1 or n > 5 then print_line("red", "[shinykeep] Usage: shinykeep include 1-5") return end
bset(vname(n), true) fg("gray"); echo(string.format("[shinykeep] Tier %d is now ", n)); fg("LimeGreen"); echo("INCLUDED\n"); resetFormat() end
function SK_Exclude(tier) local n = tonumber(tier) if not n or n < 1 or n > 5 then print_line("red", "[shinykeep] Usage: shinykeep exclude 1-5") return end
bset(vname(n), false) fg("gray"); echo(string.format("[shinykeep] Tier %d is now ", n)); fg("red"); echo("EXCLUDED\n"); resetFormat() end
function SK_Status() print_line("CornflowerBlue", "=== [shinykeep] Status Configuration ===") echo("\n") for tier = 1, 5 do print_tier_status(tier) end echo("\n") end
function SK_Help() print_line("CornflowerBlue", "=== [shinykeep] Help ===") echo("\n") print_line("gray", "* Watches invmon and reads DINV changes on demand to keep newly tracked items by tier prefix.") print_line("gray", "* Waits until DINV has the item name and type, then sends 'keep <id>'.") print_line("gray", "* Defaults: include tiers 1-4, exclude tier 5.") echo("\n")
print_line("gold", "Current Tier Configuration:") for tier = 1, 5 do print_tier_status(tier) end
echo("\n") print_line("gold", "Commands:") print_line("LimeGreen", " shinykeep include 1-5") print_line("gray", " - Include this tier") print_line("red", " shinykeep exclude 1-5") print_line("gray", " - Exclude this tier") print_line("cyan", " shinykeep status") print_line("gray", " - Show current config") print_line("cyan", " shinykeep help") print_line("gray", " - Show this help") end
local function SK_Init() load_saved()
local changed = false changed = set_default(vname(1), 1) or changed changed = set_default(vname(2), 1) or changed changed = set_default(vname(3), 1) or changed changed = set_default(vname(4), 1) or changed changed = set_default(vname(5), 0) or changed
if changed then save_saved() end
register_dinv_ready_handler()
print_line("gray", "[shinykeep] Mudlet script loaded. Type 'shinykeep help' for commands.") end
SK_Init()
